Submission Instructions

  1. In your repository, make a branch, change one line of a TEI file there, then change the same line differently on main. (You can do this alone; a partner is optional.)
  2. Merge the branch, resolve the conflict in VS Code by checking both readings against your image, remove the conflict markers, and commit.
  3. Run xmllint --noout (or the schema check from class) on every .xml file in your project and fix any errors.
  4. Submit the merge commit hash, the final validation output (copied into CONSOLIDATION.md), and a 100–150 word note in the same file saying what the conflict was and how you chose.
